traits.label: Durability
traits.description: How well the finish holds up to weather, washing and daily driving over the years.

traits.label: Finish Depth
traits.description: Gloss level, clarity and how much depth the color has under direct light.

traits.label: Color Range
traits.description: How many finish options are on the table — solids only, or metallics, candies and fades.

traits.label: Chip & UV Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to rock chips, road debris and fading from sun exposure.

traits.label: Turnaround Speed
traits.description: How quickly the vehicle is back in your hands. More layers and prep means more shop time.

traits.label: Clean Removal
traits.description: How easily the coating peels back off down the road, leaving the factory paint untouched.
